text: If you miss your Instant repayment date, you may be suspended from taking additional advances. If you repay within 15 days after the due date, the suspension may be lifted once your repayment completes. If you repay more than 15 days late, it may last 30 days or more, and more than 30 days late, 90 days or more. Albert also won't send an unpaid Instant advance to debt collection. Our help articles disagree on late fees, with one saying they may apply and another saying there are none, so please contact support to confirm. To avoid all this, you can request up to a 7-day extension in the app.
